page_title: CEL 3-0 VIL | Celta Vigo v Villarreal 23/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
90+2' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+1' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+1' Celta Vigo play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' The shots on goal statistics – 9:1.
87' 3 - 0 Goal! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Junior Reis to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
87' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is going to take the penalty!
87' Poor challenge! Pape Gueye (Villarreal) is penalised for tripping and Javier Alberola blows his whistle. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Celta Vigo!
85' Javier Alberola shows a yellow card to Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
83' Javier Alberola blows for a foul after Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
81' That was close. Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
81' Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) leaps like a salmon to produce a header from the resulting corner, but one of the defending players intercepts the ball and averts the danger.
81' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

80' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Junior Reis makes a brilliant save! Corner kick. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity.
80' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
79' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Javier Alberola no option but to blow his whistle.
77' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
75' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Yoel Lago and he is replaced by Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
74' Here comes a substitution. Pau Navarro (Villarreal) is brought on as a substitute for Kiko Femenia.
74' We are about to witness a substitution. Iker Losada (Celta Vigo) is replacing Fernando Lopez.
73' 57:43 – the ratio of ball possession.

71' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) receives a reproachful look from Iago Aspas. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
70' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
69' Celta Vigo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

69' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Junior Reis has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The referee signals a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
67' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
66' The referee signals a substitution. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is brought on as a substitute for Borja Iglesias.
66' The game is interrupted. Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
65' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) for Denis Suarez.
64' Ruben Uria has decided to make a change. Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) replaces Thierno Barry.
64' Santi Comesana goes off the pitch and Dani Parejo (Villarreal) comes on.
63' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
63' The Celta Vigo players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition. It will be a corner kick for Celta Vigo.
61' The rebound from the corner kick falls to Santi Comesana (Villarreal), who sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. Fine strike, but it lacks accuracy and goes wide of the goal.
61' Denis Suarez (Villarreal) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
61' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Villarreal.
60' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Javier Alberola signals.
57' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
57' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
57' Celta Vigo keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner.
55' The substitution is prepared. Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hugo Alvarez.
53' 2 - 0 Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) collects a killer pass and fires a low shot into the middle of the net, giving the goalkeeper no chance.

53' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the right post. A few inches to the left and it could have been a sweet goal!

52' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the bottom right corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Vicente Guaita.
51' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
50' Celta Vigo control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
48' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
48' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
47' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Junior Reis produces a wonderful reflex save. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Ilaix Moriba comes on the pitch for Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo).
46' Javier Alberola blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
45+4' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
45+2' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Junior Reis stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
45+1' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Javier Alberola ignores the protests.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' 1 - 0 Goal! Fran Beltran displays great vision and sends a pass to Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
42' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Junior Reis, who smothers the ball.

42' Junior Reis pulls off a decent save! Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
40' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) takes a shot from a mid-range free kick and the ball flies inches wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
39' The manager makes a subsitution with Logan Costa (Villarreal) coming on for Yeremy Pino.
37' Javier Alberola shows a red card with no hesitation. Eric Bailly (Villarreal) can have an early bath and think about his challenge.
36' Celta Vigo are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
34' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.

33' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
33' Denis Suarez (Villarreal) takes the corner.

33' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play and Villarreal manage to earn a corner.
32' Javier Alberola blows his whistle. Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) commits a foul after dangerous play.
31' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:0.
29' Flag up against Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
29' Foul! Thierno Barry (Villarreal) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
28' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
27' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
26' Celta Vigo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
24' Javier Alberola blows his whistle after Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
23' What a great touch by Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
22' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
21' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
21' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) commits a rough foul. Javier Alberola stops the game and makes a call.

19' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Vicente Guaita pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
17' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
16' 60:40 – the latest ball possession ratio.
14' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

14' Villarreal are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. The linesman makes the right call and Villarreal will have a corner.
12' Villarreal are ruled offside.
11' The Villarreal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for an infringement.

6' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) receives the ball from the set piece and unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
5' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is easily saved by Junior Reis.
4' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
4' The Celta Vigo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Villarreal.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Villarreal will have the kick-off.
Javier Alberola is introduced as the referee for today's match.
